notes.title: The third patch is live
notes.notes:
Dear Players! The thirtd patch for Observer System Redux is live! We continued our work on fixing bugs Many thanks to everyone who gave their feedback!

Changelog:

- Dynamic Resolution available
- Light and level streaming optimized
- Raytracing optimized
- Minor graphic issues fixed
- Razer Chroma support implemented
- It Runs In The Family: Tkaczyk's computer monitor is readable even when the room is dark
- Errant Signal: computer in the basement should no longer have issues with text dispay (white screen) preventing the player from finishing the quest
- Doors leading to the room 210 should no longer be doubled
- In-game collectibles' menu shows the correct maximum amount of patients' cards

More updates coming soon!

notes.title: The second patch is live
notes.notes:
Dear Players! The second patch for Observer System Redux is live! We continued our work on fixing bugs indicated by you, our community. Many thanks to everyone who gave their feedback!

- Amir's investigation: TV screen from the riddle is no longer clouded by a nearby light
- Helena's investigation: It is no longer possible to get blocked while passing the doors while holding TV cable
- Helena's investigation: It is no longer possible to get out of the world while holding TV cable in the kitchen
- It runs in the family: Padlock interaction icon should always be visible for the players using mouse & keyboard
- Errant Signal: All texts in the computer in the basement are localised now
- Resolution list no longer dissapears from the options menu
- Text on the in-game screens should be easier to read while playing with "Low" graphics settings
- All minigames should scale properly after changing FOV settings
- Minor graphic issues fixed

More updates coming soon!

notes.title: Patch is Live
notes.notes:
Dear Players! The first patch for Observer System Redux is live! 
In this update, we focused on fixing bugs indicated by you, our community. Many thanks to everyone who gave their feedback! 

Fixed issues:
It runs in the family: letters on the padlock should be easier to read
It runs in the family: quest progress should no longer be erased after starting the quest, leaving the room 208 and getting back later to finish it
Errant Signal: basement comparment's door should always open after solving the riddle, preventing the player from getting stuck in the basement.
Victor's investigation: player should be able to drag the closet in Victor's hideout during Victor's neural investigation.

We are already working on the next major update to increase the game's performance and solve problems related to the proper work of the game on the latest models of graphics cards.
